A good choice. From now on, you'll earn Advancement Points every level.
When you've grown used to it, come back. The Awakening Trial awaits.
새 힘을 시험해 보고 싶으면 다시 협곡의 누리를 찾아가라. 일손이 모자라: If you want to test your new power, go see Nuri in the canyon again. She looked short of hands.
그물 추가 불길에 다 녹아 버렸어. 물고기가 있어도 그물이 가라앉질 않네: My net weights all melted in the fire. Even with fish around, the nets won't sink.
해골한테서 나오는 단단한 뼈 조각 열두 개만 구해 줄래? 추로 쓰기에 딱: Could you get me twelve hard bone fragments from skeletons? They're perfect for weights.
Thanks! This is enough for new net weights.
A potion made from today's catch. Take it when you go hunting.
Every night skeletons scratch at my field fence. I'm too scared to sleep.
해골 숲 입구의 해골을 좀 줄여 줄 수 있을까?: Could you thin out the skeletons at the entrance of the Skeleton Woods?
오늘 밤은 조용하겠네. 정말 고마워!: Tonight will be quiet. Thank you so much!
I'll share the harvest with you first. This is a thank-you for now.
마을을 다시 지으려면 나무를 한참 더 베야 하는데, 숲길에 해골이 득실거: To rebuild the village I need to cut a lot more wood, but the forest path is swarming with skeletons.
Will you drive off the skeletons on my forest path? I'll do the chopping.
That's reassuring! With this I can roof a few more houses.
Mana potions. Especially good for friends who use magic.
A wagon coming down the ruins road turned back under a hail of arrows.
해골 궁수들을 좀 치워 주세요. 보답은 확실히 할게요!: Please clear out the skeleton archers. I'll pay you back, I promise!
The wagon got in safely! You saved my shop.
Ten potions. I'm counting on you from here on.
The mine shafts are scorched by the fire. Timber props alone won't hold.
The skeletons carry Enhancement Stones around. Collect ten for me.
Good stone. With this I'll prop up the shafts properly.
A Gear Protection Ticket. You shouldn't lose gear while enhancing.
The iron I made from those last bones was pretty useful.
This time I need fifty. The skeleton bones in the Blackroot Forest are hard.
Excellent. With bones like these, I could even make the Order's swords.
Essence left over from enhancing. It's precious, so use it sparingly.
I hear shield-bearing skeletons are marching in lines through the Blackroot Forest.
Break them before they come down to the village.
Dependable as ever. The villagers can rest easy now.
A small reward. It'll come in handy on your journey.
I ran into a golem pack crossing the pass. One of my cart wheels went flying.
Clear the pass so the next cart can get through.
The cart made it over safely! My honor as a merchant is saved.
Good work. I brought plenty of potions, so take some.
그러고 보니 손놀림이 예사롭지 않네. 작은 마을 광장의 전직 안내원을 찾: Come to think of it, your moves aren't ordinary. Go see the Advancement Guide in the small village square. Around level 15, they'll set your path.
Passing the Order's trial isn't the end. Real fights are the true training.
Defeat sixty Golem Throwers on the pass and come back.
You've got a feel for slipping between flying rocks now, right? That's a knight's step.
필드와 던전은 싸우는 법이 다르다. 좁은 방에서 동료와 호흡을 맞춰야 하: Fields and dungeons are fought differently. In tight rooms you have to keep pace with your comrades.
Clear a weekday dungeon once and come back. Any difficulty will do.
Good. You've learned to catch your breath between rooms.
기사단이 강화석을 잔뜩 주문했어. 그런데 채석장이 해골 소굴이 됐지 뭐야: The Order ordered a load of Enhancement Stones. But the quarry has become a skeleton den.
Get me just twenty. I'll pay you well.
Right on time! Now the delivery deadline is no problem.
Two essences as a bonus. A merchant never forgets a favor.
The quarry golems are digging tunnels. Looks like they're searching for something.
Take down the Chargers so the tunnels they dug cave in.
The digging has stopped. I'll keep looking into what they were after.
The golem warriors on the ridge are carving our Order's crest.
Maybe they're copying our old comrades. Let them rest in peace.
...Thank you. I'll bury the broken crest pieces in the Order's graveyard.
A protection ticket. Your gear, at least, has to be kept safe.
If the inn's fireplace goes out, travelers freeze.
장작 패러 가는 숲길을 설산 예티가 막고 있어요. 마흔 마리만 쫓아 주세: Snow Peak Yetis are blocking the forest path where I chop firewood. Please drive off forty of them. I'll have warm soup ready.
The fire's roaring! Everyone will sleep soundly tonight.
The inn's special potion. You won't feel the cold at all.
Yeti Throwers are hiding in the pine forest, preying on hunters.
It's hard to dodge flying chunks of ice on snow. Clear them out carefully.
The hunters can go back into the woods now. Thank you.
Potions the village gathered. Take them.
Yeti Warders stand like a wall on the icy lakeshore road.
생선을 못 받으면 여관 문을 닫아야 해요. 도와주세요!: If I can't get fish, I'll have to close the inn. Please help!
The ice road is open! Grilled fish for dinner tonight.
A protection ticket a guest left behind. You need it more than I do.
The ward stone at the village entrance is losing its light.
Six essences from deep in the dungeons should wake it again.
The ward stone is breathing again. Now we're safe even at night.
Two protection tickets. Use them if a big enhancement is ahead.
Yeti warriors are gathering on the peak. As if something is drawing them.
Let's climb to the top. The answer is past it.
The peak has gone quiet. Only the final battle remains.
Essence I picked up on the peak. Use it to refine your gear.
I've heard the rumors about you. Even this small village has many places that need a hand.
Help with five things. The whole village will remember.
Thanks to you, the village has the strength to last the winter.
The village's blessing. Your body will feel much sturdier.
Welcome to Snowflower Village. It's a cold place, but the people are warm.
Welcome! Warm yourself up before you go. The soup's always hot.
그라흐는 마족 장수 중에서도 손꼽히는 자다. 지금 들어가면 돌아오지 못한: Grah is one of the most fearsome demonkin generals. Go in now and you won't come back.
북쪽 눈꽃 마을에 가 봐라. 설원의 사냥꾼들이 미친 설산 예티와 싸우고: Go to Snowflower Village in the north. The snowfield hunters are fighting crazed Snow Peak Yetis. Build your strength there.
그리고 해골왕의 봉인 열쇠 조각을 계속 모아라. 석실 문은 그것 예순 개: And keep collecting the Skeleton King's Seal Key Fragments. The chamber door opens with sixty of them.
So you're Lady Leona's knight. You've come a long way.
이 마을은 봉우리의 미친 예티 때문에 매일이 전쟁이라네. 사냥꾼 하람과: Every day is a war in this village because of the crazed yetis on the peak. Help Haram the hunter and the villagers.
Once you're strong enough, you'll be able to face the guardian of the chamber.
우선 사냥꾼 하람을 찾아가게. 서리 소나무 숲이 예티 천지라 사냥을 못: First go see Haram the hunter. The Frostpine Forest is overrun with yetis, and he hasn't hunted in ages.
해빙된 성소 입구에서 예티들이 미쳐 날뛰고 있어. 봉인이 녹으면서 새어: The yetis are going wild at the Thawed Sanctum Entrance. Probably the energy leaking out as the seal melts.
방패 든 놈 예순, 돌 던지는 놈 마흔. 입구를 열어 줘야 마을이 안전해: Sixty with shields, forty that throw rocks. The entrance must be cleared for the village to be safe.
입구가 조용해졌어. 녹아내린 봉인은 어쩔 수 없지만, 이제 가까이 갈 수: The entrance has gone quiet. Nothing to be done about the melting seal, but now we can get close.
A protection ticket. It'll be rougher inside, so save it.
The Chief knows more about what's inside. Go see Chief Sera.
성소 입구가 열렸다니, 이제 안으로 들어가 볼 수 있겠군. 물에 잠긴 회: If the sanctum entrance is open, we can finally look inside. I hear there's a flooded corridor.
그곳의 돌 석상들이 깨어났다는 소문이야. 예순만 쓰러뜨려 주게. 무리는: Rumor is the stone statues there have awakened. Just take down sixty. Don't overdo it.
The statues in the corridor have quieted down. Good work.
회랑 너머에 잠긴 서고가 있다네. 반쯤 지워진 비문이 남아 있다고 하더군: Past the corridor lies a sunken library. They say a half-erased inscription remains there.
읽을 수 있을지는 모르겠네. 우선 서고를 지키는 석상 투척병부터 정리해: I don't know if it can be read. First clear out the Statue Throwers guarding the library.
비문 말인가. 반쯤 지워져서 몇 글자만 읽히더군. 함께, 라는 글자가 보: The inscription? It's half erased, so only a few letters can be read. I thought I saw the word 'together'.
That's all I know. For now, here's a protection ticket.
성소 아래 지하묘가 뿌리에 먹히고 있어. 굵은 뿌리가 무덤 벽을 뚫고 올: The catacombs under the sanctum are being eaten by roots. They say thick roots are breaking through the tomb walls.
Statue Warders stand guard in there too. Take down about sixty.
The roots will be quiet for a while. I don't know what they were guarding, but that's quite a feat.
You've passed through both the library and the catacombs. Now the last one, the Hall of Oblivion.
내전에 석상이 백 기쯤 서 있다더군. 쓰러뜨리고 안쪽 벽도 한번 살펴봐: They say about a hundred statues stand in the hall. Take them down and look at the inner wall while you're there.
벽화를 봤다고? 두 손이... 하나는 사람의 손이고 하나는 사람이 아닌: You saw a mural? Two hands... one a human hand and one not human?
...그런 이야기는 어른들께 들은 적이 없네. 왜 아무도 말해 주지 않았: ...I never heard such a story from the elders. I wonder why no one ever told us.
Thank you. A protection ticket and an Ancient Core. I'll think more about this.
...그리고 협곡의 대사제가 사람을 보내 자네를 찾더군. 열쇠 조각이 모: ...And the High Priest in the canyon sent someone looking for you. He says to come to the chamber once you've gathered the key fragments. He seemed in a hurry.
상류는 뚫렸는데 물이 반밖에 안 내려와. 옛 수로 합류지에 또 해골들이: The upper river is clear, but only half the water comes down. They say skeletons have gathered again at the old canal junction.
That's the last chokepoint. Just once more, please.
The waterway is finally clear. Thanks to you, even the village well will have plenty.
참, 바위 협곡에서 온 상인 누리가 길이 험해 장사를 못 한다고 하소연하: Oh, Nuri, the merchant from Rock Canyon, was complaining that the roads are too rough to trade. Go see the canyon.
강화석 고마워. 그런데 이번엔 채석장 길이 아예 막혔어. 골렘 돌격병이랑: Thanks for the Enhancement Stones. But now the quarry road is completely blocked. Golem Chargers and Warders are holding it in droves.
길만 뚫어 주면 기사단 납품도, 북쪽 고개로 가는 사람들도 한숨 돌릴 거: If you clear the road, the Order's deliveries and travelers to the North Pass can breathe easy.
The road is clear! Now carts can come and go without worry.
그런데 일꾼들 말이, 채석장 안쪽에 처음 보는 검은 깃발이 섰대. 좀 꺼: But the workers say a strange black banner went up deep in the quarry. It bothers me.
흑철로 만든 깃발이래. 골렘들이 그 깃발 주변에 모여서 뭘 지키고 있다나: They say it's a banner of black iron. The golems are gathered around it, guarding something.
Can you go all the way inside? Don't push yourself.
흑철 진영이라고? 그 바르가스라는 놈 이야기는 나도 들었어. 해골왕이랑: The Blackiron Camp? I've heard about that Vargas guy too. They say he's allied with the Skeleton King...
이건 상인이 감당할 일이 아니야. 작은 마을의 카엘에게 알려. 그 사람이: This is too much for a merchant. Tell Kael in the small village. He'll know what to do.
숲 북쪽 끝에서 호숫가로 내려가는 길이 있어. 그런데 예티들이 거길 막고: There's a path down to the lakeshore from the north end of the woods. But yetis are blocking it.
요즘 밤마다 호수 쪽 하늘이 푸르스름해. 길을 열어야 무슨 일인지 볼 수: Lately the sky over the lake glows bluish every night. We have to open the path to see what's going on.
길이 열렸다. 호숫가가 내려다보이더군. 얼음 위에 예티 전사들이 잔뜩이야: The path is open. You can see the lakeshore below. The ice is full of yeti warriors.
The fishermen haven't gone out for weeks. The lakeshore is next.
Haram told me. A blue light is rising from under the lake ice.
예티들이 그 빛 주변에만 모여 사나워진다더군. 빛 가까이 가서 무엇인지: They say the yetis gather only around that light and turn vicious. Will you go near it and see what it is?
얼음 아래 물길이 북쪽 성소에서 흘러온다고? ...그렇다면 그 빛은 성소: The water under the ice flows from the northern sanctum? ...Then that light must be leaking from the sanctum's seal.
옛 어른들은 그 성소에 무언가를 가두어 두었다고 하셨네. 지키라고 둔 것: The elders said something was locked away in that sanctum. Not placed there to protect, but to imprison.
레오나 경이 말한 수호석과 같은 것일까. ...하람이 봉우리 쪽 길목을: Could it be the same as the Wardstone Lady Leona spoke of? ...Haram is scouting the path toward the peak. Go see him.
봉우리 위쪽 예티들이 한꺼번에 아래로 내려오고 있어. 위에서 뭔가에 쫓기: The yetis on the upper peak are all coming down at once. As if something up there is chasing them.
We have to hold the chokepoint to climb the peak. Let's break through together.
We hold the chokepoint. Packs of yeti warriors keep coming down from the summit.
Now we can see head-on where they're coming from.
Going in and out of the Skeleton Woods with nothing on? You're fearless.
사냥하다 주운 장비는 가방에 쌓아 두지 말고 몸에 걸쳐. 장비창(I)을: Don't pile gear from hunting in your bag, wear it. Open the gear window (I) and drag it on or click to equip.
검이든 옷이든 레벨이 맞아야 입을 수 있다. 빨간 글씨면 아직 이르다는: Swords or clothes, you need the right level to wear them. Red text means it's still too early.
Much better. Now you look the part.
I put in a few Enhancement Stones. Next time, let's heat some iron with them.
Gear isn't done once you wear it. Temper it with Enhancement Stones and it gains attack and defense.
나한테 말을 걸고 강화를 골라. 단계가 오를수록 실패하기 쉽고, 높은 단: Talk to me and pick Enhance. The higher the level, the easier it fails, and at high levels it can break.
그럴 땐 장비 보호권을 써라. 지금은 낮은 단계라 걱정 말고 한 번 해: That's when you use a Gear Protection Ticket. It's a low level now, so don't worry and give it a try.
See? When the hammer sounds good, the iron gets better.
I gave you more Enhancement Stones. Use them carefully, iron with bone in it is rare.
Oh my, your bag's about to burst. Sell me the gear and materials you don't use.
판매 탭에서 고르면 바로 골드로 바꿔 드려요. 같은 직업이 못 쓰는 장비: Pick them in the Sell tab and I'll turn them into Gold right away. I'll even pay for gear your class can't use.
Buy potions with the spare Gold and hunting gets much easier.
Thanks for the business! As a regular, I'll throw in a few mana potions.
Leave materials you don't need right now with me. Your bag needs empty slots for new loot.
창고는 같은 계정의 다른 캐릭터와도 나눠 써요. 재료 모두 맡기기 버튼이: Storage is shared with the other characters on the same account. The Store All Materials button does it in one go.
I'll keep them safe. Come get them anytime.
Lost? Open the world map (M) and it shows the recommended level for each hunting ground.
그리고 할 일이 정해져 있을 땐 자동 진행(F6)을 켜요. 다음 목적지까: And when you know what to do next, turn on Auto Quest (F6). It walks you to the next destination.
그거예요! 마을 귀환 주문서도 몇 장 드릴게요. 멀리 나갔다 돌아올 때: That's it! I'll give you a few Village Return Scrolls too. Use them when you're far away and want to come back.
사냥터에선 자동 사냥(F7)을 켜 두면 가까운 해골부터 알아서 상대한다네: At a hunting ground, turn on Auto Hunt (F7) and it'll take on the nearest skeletons for you.
물약도 체력이 낮으면 알아서 마시지. 다만 보스나 던전은 직접 싸워야 하: It'll drink potions when your HP is low too. But bosses and dungeons, you fight yourself.
Well done. Take plenty of potions.
Every skill has two Support Gem slots.
추가 피해, 범위 확대, 마력 효율 같은 젬을 끼우면 같은 스킬도 성격이: Fit gems like Extra Damage, Wider Area or Mana Efficiency and the same skill changes character. Some gems cost more mana, so be sure to read the gem guide.
Open the skill window (K) and click an empty slot in the Gems tab.
Good, that familiar skill has a sharper edge now.
제 가게에 없는 물건은 경매장(U)에서 구해 보세요. 다른 모험가들이 올: For things my shop doesn't carry, try the Auction House (U). Other adventurers list gear and materials there.
다른 직업 장비가 나오면 거기 올려서 팔면 상점보다 비싸게 받을 수도 있: If you get gear for another class, list it there and you might get more than the shop pays.
Enjoy looking around? I'll add a little Gold for your trading.
던전이 버겁거든 혼자 가지 말게. 파티 찾기(O)에서 같이 갈 모험가를: If a dungeon is too much, don't go alone. You can find adventurers to go with in Party Finder (O).
동료가 없으면 용병을 데려가도 되지. 수호자가 앞에서 막고, 비숍이 뒤에: With no comrades, you can bring Mercenaries. A Guardian blocking up front and a Bishop looking after you from behind is reassuring.
I hope you meet good comrades. Share your potions.
이제 마을 일도 좀 맡아 주게. 메뉴의 일일 의뢰에 그날 그날 부탁이 올: Now take on some village work too. Each day's requests appear under Daily Quests in the menu.
하루 세 건, 주간 의뢰도 따로 있지. 레벨에 맞는 사냥터 의뢰가 뜨니: Three a day, and there are weekly quests too. They're for hunting grounds that match your level, so do them on your way.
Thank you. A little every day makes both the village and you stronger.
전직 기술은 처음엔 막막하지. 스킬 창(K) 전직 탭의 추천 배치를 누르: Advancement skills are daunting at first. Press Recommended Setup in the Advancement tab of the skill window (K) and it learns the standard build and puts it on your keys.
그리고 스타일 버튼을 보게. 파티용과 솔로용 배치를 따로 저장해 두고 버: And look at the Style button. You can save separate party and solo setups and switch with one button.
Solo for hunting alone, Party for dungeons with comrades. Make both.
Good, now you're ready for any fight.
The quarry is still dangerous. Go in now and the golems will trample you.
먼저 붉은 돌 고개에서 암석 골렘을 여든 마리쯤 쓰러뜨려 봐. 그만큼이면: First take down about eighty Rock Golems at Redrock Pass. That'll be enough to hold out in the quarry.
고개가 한결 조용해졌어. 이제 채석장도 해볼 만하겠는데?: The pass is much quieter. Now the quarry looks doable, right?
Take some potions. The quarry golems are much tougher.
The banner inside bothers me, but the Chargers outside are still roaming in packs.
돌격병을 여든 마리 정리해 줘. 그동안 너도 안쪽에 들어갈 만큼 단단해질: Clear out eighty Chargers. Meanwhile you'll get tough enough to go inside.
The Chargers have thinned out a lot. Now we can look inside.
Thanks. Next time I'll ask you about the banner.
That banner is the Blackiron Camp for sure. It's too much for us right now.
채석장의 골렘 수호병을 여든 마리 쓰러뜨리자. 단단한 놈들을 상대해 봐야: Let's take down eighty Golem Warders in the quarry. You improve by facing tough ones.
좋아, 몸이 많이 가벼워졌지? 이제 해골왕의 요새에 도전할 준비가 거의: Good, you feel a lot lighter, right? You're almost ready to take on the Skeleton King's fortress.
A little stronger and we'll set out right away.

Welcome to Snowflower Woods Village!
If you're frozen, head to the campfire at the east rest area.
(눈 덮인 나무 문이다. 너머 고개에는 아직 눈보라가 거세다.): (A snow-covered wooden gate. A blizzard still rages on the pass beyond.)
(굴뚝에서 연기가 피어오른다. 안에서 따뜻한 차 냄새가 난다.): (Smoke rises from the chimney. You smell warm tea inside.)
(외양간이 비어 있다. 봄이 오면 동물들이 돌아온다고 한다.): (The barn is empty. They say the animals return in spring.)
(모닥불이 타닥타닥 타오른다. 언 손이 금세 녹는다.): (The campfire crackles. Your frozen hands warm up in no time.)
Too many golems in the pass. Clear the road so the caravans can get through.
Rocks rain down from above and nobody can cross. Deal with the throwers first.
수레가 또 고개에 멈췄어요. 돌격병들이 길을 막고 있어요. 부탁해요!: My cart is stuck on the pass again. Chargers are blocking the road. Please!
채석장에 연장을 두고 왔는데 돌격병이 지키고 있어요. 좀 치워 주실래요?: I left my tools in the quarry and chargers are guarding them. Could you clear them out?
Guards are blocking the entrance with their shields. Please bring that wall down.
Some miners are trapped inside. Without the guards they could walk out.
The guards are massed under the banner. Break them and the road to the fortress opens.
Chargers keep climbing out of the depths. We have to cut off the flow.
We can't leave our back open. Let's sweep the chargers one more time.
The throwers on the ridge keep my patrols from climbing. Open the way.
Even the knights struggle with the ridge's golem warriors. Show me what you can do.
The supply carts are stuck on the ridge. Clear the chargers and they can move again.
There are tracks right up to the village. Let's send those yetis back.
Every trap we set, the throwers smash. Teach them a lesson, please.
Guards are planted on the forest path. We have to push them out to go hunting.
사냥꾼 하나가 아직 돌아오지 않았네. 숲의 예티를 쫓아내고 길을 열어 주: One hunter still hasn't returned. Drive off the yetis in the forest and open the way.
The guards have settled in the middle of the forest. Scatter them for us.
We're out of firewood. If not for the yetis on the path, I'd fetch it in no time.
Before heading to the lake, let's clear the throwers at the crossing. Getting hit from behind is bad.
Guards line the ice on the shore. Let's bring them down one by one.
The children fetching water at the lake are in danger. Please clear the throwers.
Not a single guest comes to the inn because of those warriors. Please help.
Guards took the ice fishing spot. I can't make any fish dishes at this rate.
More and more warriors circle the lake. Let's do a big sweep this time.
불빛이 보이는 자리에 투척병이 모여 있네. 가까이 가 보려면 먼저 치워야: Throwers gather where the light shows. We must clear them to get close.
호숫가에 옛날 물건이 떠밀려 왔대요. 수호병만 없으면 주워 올 수 있어요: Old things washed up on the shore. Without the guards I could collect them.
Before climbing the peak, let's tidy up behind us. The lakeshore guards first.
봉우리로 가는 분들 준비물을 챙기려면 호숫가를 지나야 해요. 전사들 좀: To pack supplies for the peak team we must pass the lake. Please clear the warriors.
Throwers hold the hill where we light the beacon. Take that spot back for us.
We need to move supplies to the foot of the peak. Clear the guards on the road.
Yeti warriors have taken the hill we signal from. I'm counting on you.
The peak's watchers block the way. We have to get past them to go higher.
Throwers hunt the expedition in the blizzard. Clear them out ahead of time.
Guards have blocked the ice road toward the sanctum. Please open the way.
Let's clean up behind us before entering the sanctum. Yetis following us would be trouble.
The statues in the hall are moving. Stop the throwers first.
Good work. The pass is much quieter. Take this.
I knew I could count on you! Here's the reward I promised.
Well done. This gets us one step further.
Excellent. I will repay you in the order's name.
Clean work. A hunter's share, from one hunter to another.
Thank you so much! We gathered this at the inn, please take it.
Thank you. The village gathered this. Take it with you.
